Paragraph with bold, italic, and a link

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<p>This has <strong>bold</strong>, <em>italic</em>, and a <a href=\"https://example.com\">link</a>.</p>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);

}
```
